Proposed slots (APAC-friendly, 45m):

Thanks — I can send a calendar hold once Samira confirms preferred slot.

Chloe / Samira —

I can host the technical portion for both proposed slots. Quick infra notes:
- Staging: we can run the demo on Redwood hosted with a dedicated ephemeral namespace (recommended) or we can run in Nebula's AWS account. If Nebula prefers customer-hosted, please create an IAM role with the following minimal policy scope (S3 read, CloudWatch read) and add redwood-demo@amazon-ops as the principal.
- Token/sample limits: set a sandbox cap at ~50k tokens for the rehearsal to avoid throttles. If we use hosted, we will pre-load a small prefix cache to shave 200–300ms latency on the first walkthrough.

Backup infra hosts: Rishi (infra lead) available 20 Aug 14:00–19:00 SGT; I'm available for both slots but recommend Rishi join rehearsal in case we need rapid swap.

Preflight checklist (high level):
- Confirm sample S3 share or upload to our secure staging bucket
- Provide any firewall/egress allowlist for sandbox endpoints (IP ranges attached in runbook)
- Confirm whether we'll demonstrate multi-region fallback (if yes, please tell us the desired failover region)

Attachement: preflight-checklist.md

I'll be on the rehearsal 30 minutes early.

— Vivek
